# Jesus Prays for Us (John 17:9)

## Emotional Focus
Knowing Jesus prays for us.

## Key KJV
“I pray for them.” (John 17:9)

## Gentle Retelling
Before He went to the cross, Jesus prayed for His friends — and for us. He asked God to keep us safe and close to Him.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus kneeling and praying with open hands, soft light around Him.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus is praying for you right now — you are never alone.”
